website_summary.name: Fortune Wheel Spinner
website_summary.description: The website features a vibrant and interactive design centered around a spinning wheel game with a prize list and user records.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a clean and engaging layout with a prominent blue spinning wheel on the left side, featuring various prize segments such as Bronze Coupon, Silver Voucher, Gold Reward, Diamond Gift, Platinum Prize, and Mystery Box. The wheel is bordered by a bold dark red outline, matching the theme color used throughout the site. On the right side, there is a neatly organized prize list within a dark red box, listing all potential prizes with corresponding icons. Below the prize list, there is a button labeled "View My Winning Records," inviting users to track their past spins. The overall background is a light gray, providing a neutral backdrop that highlights the colorful elements of the wheel and buttons.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers several key functionalities: users can spin the wheel by clicking the "Spin the Wheel" button located below the wheel. This action triggers the wheel to spin and eventually stop on a random prize segment. Users can also view a comprehensive prize list detailing all available rewards. Additionally, there is a feature allowing users to access their winning records, enabling them to keep track of their past spins and prizes won. The website ensures an interactive experience with clear calls-to-action and responsive design elements.

functionality_testing.name: Claim Prize Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the CLAIM PRIZE button allows the user to claim the won prize.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The spinning animation has completed, and the pop-up message with the "CLAIM PRIZE" button is visible.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The prize is claimed successfully, and the pop-up message disappears. 7. Next Steps : Click the "CLAIM PRIZE" button to claim the won prize.
procedure: Click on the CLAIM PRIZE button.
Verify that the prize is claimed successfully.

functionality_testing.name: SPIN THE WHEEL Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the SPIN THE WHEEL button initiates the spinning animation and stops at a random prize.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The wheel is static and the "SPIN THE WHEEL" button is visible.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The wheel spins, stops at a random prize, and the selected prize is clearly indicated. 7. Next Steps : Click the "SPIN THE WHEEL" button to initiate the spinning animation.
procedure: Click on the SPIN THE WHEEL button.
Observe the spinning animation.
Verify that the wheel stops at a random prize and the selected prize is clearly indicated.
